Terms and conditions

Last updated: 2026-11-01

In plain words: Stamp gives shopkeepers a digital stamp card for their customers. Shops must honour the rewards they set. Customers must scan honestly. We can void stamps if something looks wrong, and we log the reason.

What this service is

Stamp is a digital stamp card and scratch card platform. Shop owners create a loyalty program. Customers scan a QR code at the shop to collect stamps, may receive scratch card prizes, and claim rewards when their card is full.

By using Stamp, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

Accounts and one-time codes

Customers sign in with their mobile number and a one-time code sent by SMS. You are responsible for keeping your phone number secure. Do not share one-time codes with anyone.

Shop owners are given accounts by Stamp administrators. Each account is tied to one shop.

Shop responsibilities

  • Honour rewards: you must give the reward you set in your program when a customer presents a valid claim code.
  • Accurate program: set realistic stamps-to-reward ratios and honest scratch card prizes.
  • Lawful prizes: all prizes and rewards must comply with local laws. Do not offer anything illegal or misleading.
  • Data use: you may only use customer data visible in your dashboard for the purpose of running your loyalty program. Do not sell or share it.

Customer responsibilities

  • Scan honestly: only scan the QR when you are physically at the shop.
  • No code sharing: do not share claim codes or screenshots of them with others.
  • One account: use one account per person. Do not create multiple accounts to collect extra stamps.

Fraud and voiding

Shop owners and Stamp administrators may void stamps, prizes, or rewards if:

  • A stamp was collected without a genuine visit (for example, scanning from a photo).
  • Multiple accounts are used by the same person.
  • Any other misuse is detected.

Every void action is logged with a reason, visible to both the shop and the customer.

Availability and maintenance

We aim to keep Stamp running at all times, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted service. We may take the service offline for maintenance with reasonable notice when possible.

If the internet connection at a shop drops, the QR code stops rotating and customers cannot collect stamps until the connection is restored.

No warranty of sales results

Stamp is a tool for customer loyalty. We do not guarantee that it will increase your sales, foot traffic, or customer retention. Results depend on your business, your rewards, and your customers.

Limits of liability

To the maximum extent permitted by law, [[FILL: legal entity name, e.g. "Stamp Technologies LLP"]] is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of Stamp.

Our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you have paid us in the 12 months before the claim, or ₹5,000, whichever is greater.

Termination

You may stop using Stamp at any time. Shop owners can contact us to deactivate their program.

We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms, with notice when possible.

On termination, customer stamps and rewards for that shop are no longer redeemable.

Governing law and courts

These terms are governed by the laws of India. Disputes will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in [[FILL: city, e.g. "Pune, Maharashtra"]].
